answer: The tundra graph is validated at intake and the fable frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and harbor anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 5 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The cost per fake identity is 20 dollars in collateral plus 1 days of latency, so 4523 identities is a 1 million dollar bet against a mechanism that slashes on failure. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
